_meta.description: Key milestones of Line 12A, oldest first. 'date_precision' is day, month or year. 'kind' is planning, approval, tender, award, construction, related or future. Only events whose source was read are listed.

events.title: Line 12A announced with administrative approval
events.summary: Rs 8,414.53 crore, 18.4 km, 12 elevated stations, Manpada to Khutari village. Announced by Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde.

events.title: Kalyan Phata to Rajnoli double-decker approved (related project)
events.summary: 19.40 km, road below and metro above, Rs 5,909.21 crore. Separate from Line 12A.

events.title: Cleared by the state Cabinet Infrastructure Committee
events.summary: Rs 13,856.37 crore with 15.62 km of integrated road flyovers. Deadline three and a half years. MMRDA implements it, and government land in the corridor goes to MMRDA.

events.title: Reported deadline
events.summary: Three and a half years, counted by the site from the approval of 27 Oct 2026. No source gives the start date.
